verses.1:4: Noah. The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, Japheth.
verses.1:5: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Elishah, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.1:6: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.1:7: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, the Kittim and the Rhodians.
verses.1:8: And the sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim, Put and Canaan.
verses.1:9: And the sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.1:10: And Cush fathered Nimrod; he began to be a giant hunter upon the earth.
verses.1:17: The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur,
verses.1:28: Now the sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.1:29: Now these are the generations of the firstborn of Ishmael: Nebaioth and Kedar, Adbeel, Massa,
verses.1:31: Jetur, Naphish, Kedemah; these are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.1:32: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine—she bore to him Zimran, Jokshan, Midian, Medan, Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Dedan and Sheba.
verses.1:33: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
verses.1:34: And Abraham fathered Isaac. And the sons of Isaac: Jacob and Esau.
verses.1:35: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.1:36: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman and Omar, Zophar, Gatam, and Kenaz, and by Timna, Amalek.
verses.1:37: And the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.1:38: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, and Onan.
verses.1:39: And the sons of Lotan: Hori, Heman, Elath, and Namna.
verses.1:40: The sons of Shobal: Solam, Manahath, Ebal, Shob, and Onan. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Sonan.
verses.1:41: The sons of Sonan: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.1:42: And the sons of Ezer: Balaam, Zukam, and Onan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.1:43: And these are their kings: Balak the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.1:44: And Balak died, and Jobab the son of Zerah, from Bozrah, reigned in his place.
verses.1:45: And Jobab died, and Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.1:46: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Barad, who struck down Midian in the plain of Moab, reigned in his place, and the name of his city was Gethaim.
verses.1:47: And Hadad died, and in his place reigned—
verses.1:48: And Hadda died, and Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place; and Samlah died, and Shaul from Rehoboth by the river reigned in his place. And Shaul died. And there were chiefs of Edom: Chief Teman, Chief Gola, Chief Jethet,
verses.1:50: And Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadad the son of Barad reigned in his place, and the name of his city was Peor.
verses.1:51: The chiefs of Edom: Chief Timna, Chief Golada, Chief Jether,
verses.1:52: Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,
verses.1:53: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,
verses.1:54: Chief Magdiel, Chief Zaphoin; these are the chiefs of Edom.
verses.2:1: These are the names of the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
verses.2:2: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, Asher.
verses.2:3: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, three; they were born to him by the daughter of Aua the Canaanite woman. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was wicked before the Lord, and He slew him.
verses.2:4: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bore to him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.2:5: The sons of Perez: Harson and Jemuel.
verses.2:6: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, Etham, Haimuan, Calca, and Dara, five in all.
verses.2:7: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed concerning the devoted thing.
verses.2:8: And the sons of Etham: Zaria.
verses.2:9: And the sons of Hezron who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, Chabel, and Aram.
verses.2:10: And Arran fathered Amminadab, and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, ruler of the house of Judah.
verses.2:11: And Nahshon fathered Salmon, and Salmon fathered Boaz.
verses.2:12: And Boaz fathered Obed, and Obed fathered Jesse,
verses.2:13: and Jesse fathered his firstborn Eliab, Amminadab the second, Shammah the third,
verses.2:14: Nethanel the fourth, Zaddai the fifth,
verses.2:15: Asom the sixth, David the seventh.
verses.2:16: And their sister was Zeruiah; and the sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.2:17: And Abigail bore Amessab; and the father of Amessab was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.2:18: And Caleb the son of Hezron fathered Gazuba a wife, and Elioth. And these were her sons: Joasar, Jasub, and Orna.
verses.2:19: And Gazuba died, and Caleb took for himself Ephrath, and she bore to him Hur.
verses.2:20: And Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel.
verses.2:21: And after these things Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead; and he took her, and he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Seruch.
verses.2:22: And Seruch fathered Jair; and he had twenty-three cities in Gilead.
verses.2:23: And Gedsur and Arran took the villages of Saeir from them, with Kenath and its villages, sixty cities; all these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.2:24: And after Hezron died, Caleb came to Ephrathah; and the wife of Hezron was Abijah, and she bore to him Ascho, the father of Tekoa.
verses.2:25: And the sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, were the firstborn Ran, and Banaia, and Araia, and Ambram, and Asan his brother.
verses.2:26: And Jerahmeel had another wife, and her name was Atarah; she is the mother of Ozom.
verses.2:27: And the sons of Aram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Akor.
verses.2:28: And the sons of Ozom were Shammai and Jada; and the sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.
verses.2:29: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abichaia, and she bore to him Achabar and Moel.
verses.2:30: The sons of Nadab: Alsalad and Ephraim; and Salad died having no children.
verses.2:31: And the sons of Ephraim: Isemiel; and the sons of Isemiel: Sosan; and the sons of Sosan: Achai.
verses.2:32: And the sons of Iduda: Achisamas, Jether, and Jonathan; and Jether died having no children.
verses.2:33: And the sons of Jonathan: Thaleth and Ozam. These were the sons of Rameel.
verses.2:34: Now Sosam had no sons, but only daughters; and Sosam had an Egyptian servant, and his name was Jochel.
verses.2:35: And Sosan gave his daughter to Jochel his servant as a wife, and she bore to him Etthei.
verses.2:36: And Etthei fathered Nathan, and Nathan fathered Zabed,
verses.2:37: and Zabed fathered Aphamel, and Aphamel fathered Obed,
verses.2:38: and Obed fathered Joshua, and Joshua fathered Azariah,
verses.2:39: and Azariah fathered Helez, and Helez fathered Emas,
verses.2:40: and Emas fathered Sosomai, and Sosomai fathered Shallum,
verses.2:41: and Shallum fathered Jekamiah, and Jekamiah fathered Elishama.
verses.2:42: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mareshah his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.2:43: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, Thapus, Rekem, and Shema.
verses.2:44: And Shema fathered Ramee the father of Jaklan, and Jeklan fathered Shammai.
verses.2:45: And his son was Meon, and Meon was the father of Gedsur.
verses.2:46: And Gaiphael, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, Josan, and Gezue; and Haran fathered Gezue.
verses.2:47: And the sons of Joshua: Regem, Jotham, Sogar, Phalek, Gaipha, and Sagae.
verses.2:48: And Caleb's concubine Maachah bore Saber and Tharam.
verses.2:49: And she bore Sagae the father of Marmena, and Saou the father of Machabena and the father of Gaibal; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.2:50: These were the sons of Caleb. The sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Sobar the father of Kiriath-jearim,
verses.2:51: Solomon the father of Baitha, Lammon the father of Bethlehem, Harim the father of Beth-gaidon.
verses.2:52: And Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haio, Heseira, Monaio,
verses.2:53: Emospheos, the cities of Jair: Haithalim, Meiphithim, Hesamathim, and Hemasaraim; from these went forth the Sarathites and the sons of Esthaam.
verses.2:54: The sons of Solomon: Bethlehem, Metophathi, Ataroth of the house of Joab, and half of the Malathi, Hesarei,
verses.2:55: the families of writings dwelling in Games: Argathiim, Samathiim, and Sokathiim; these are the Kenites who came from Mesema, the father of the house of Recha.
verses.3:1: Now these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn was Amnon, by Ahinoam the Israelitess; the second, Damniel, by Abigail the Carmelitess;
verses.3:2: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah, the daughter of Thoamai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
verses.3:3: the fifth, Shephatiah, by Sabital; the sixth, Ithream, by Ala his wife.
verses.3:4: Six were born to him in Hebron. And he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.3:5: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Saman, Soban, Nathan, and Solomon, four by Bathsheba the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.3:9: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
verses.3:10: The sons of Solomon were Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.3:11: Joram his son, Uzziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.3:12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.3:13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.3:14: Amnon his son, and Josiah his son.
verses.3:15: And the sons of Josiah were the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
verses.3:16: And the sons of Jehoiakim were Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.
verses.3:17: And the sons of Jeconiah were Assir, Shealtiel his son,
verses.3:18: Malchiram, Phaldaias, Sanesar, Jekenia, Hosamoth, and Denethi.
verses.3:19: And the sons of Shealtiel were Zerubbabel; Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith was their sister;
verses.3:20: and Hashubah, Osa, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Arobasok—five.
verses.3:21: And the sons of Hananiah were Phalleti, and Isaba his son, Raphal his son, Orna his son, Obadiah his son, and Shecaniah his son.
verses.3:22: And the son of Shecaniah was Shemaiah; and the son of Shemaiah was Hattush, and Joel, Marei, Noadiah, and Shaphat—six.
verses.3:23: And the sons of Noadiah were Elithana, Hezekiah, and Ezrikan—three.
verses.3:24: And the sons of Elithenan were Hodoliah, Aseib, Phara, Jakun, Johanan, Delaiah, and Manei—seven.
verses.4:1: Now the sons of Judah were Perez, Harson, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
verses.4:2: And Rada was his son; and Shobal fathered Ieth, and Ieth fathered Achimei and Laath. These are the generations of Arathi.
verses.4:3: And these were the sons of Aitan: Azrael, Ragma, and Jabas; and the name of their sister was Heselebbon.
verses.4:4: And Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Azer was the father of Hosan. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethladen.
verses.4:5: And Sara the father of Tekoa had two wives, Aoda and Thoada.
verses.4:6: And Aoda bore him Ochaia, Hephal, Teman, and Aseran. All these were the sons of Aoda.
verses.4:7: And the sons of Loada were Areth, Saar, and Sennon.
verses.4:8: And Koe fathered Ennon and Sabatha, and the generations of the brother of Rechab, the son of Jarim.
verses.4:9: Now Igabes was more honorable than his brethren; and his mother called his name Igabes, saying, "I gave birth as gabes."
verses.4:10: And Igabes called upon the God of Israel, saying, "If indeed You will bless me, and multiply my borders, and Your hand will be with me, and You will grant knowledge so as not to humble me!" And God brought about all that he had asked.
verses.4:11: Now Caleb the father of Ascha fathered Machir; he was the father of Assathon.
verses.4:12: He fathered Bathraia, Bessee, and Teman, the father of the city of Nahash, the brother of Eselon the Kenizzite. These were the men of Rechab.
verses.4:13: And the sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel were Hathath.
verses.4:14: And Manathi fathered Ophrah; and Seraiah fathered Jobab, the father of Ageaddair, for they were craftsmen.
verses.4:15: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh were Ir, Adai, and Noom; and the sons of Ada were Kenaz.
verses.4:16: And the sons of Aleel were Zib, Zepha, Thiria, and Eserel.
verses.4:17: And the sons of Esrei were Jetheri, Porad, Epher, and Amon. And Jether fathered Maion, Semen, and Mareth, the father of Esthaimon.
verses.4:18: And his wife, this Adia, bore Jared the father of Gedor, and Abisa the father of Sochon, and Chethiel the father of Zamon. And these were the sons of Gelia, the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Noroel took.
verses.4:19: And the sons of the woman Idouia, the sister of Nacheth, and Dalila the father of Keilah, and Semegon the father of Joman, and of Manahem the father of Keilah: Hatamei and Esthaimone Nochathi.
verses.4:20: And the sons of Semion were Amnon, Ana the son of Phana, and Inon. And the sons of Seei were Zoan; and the sons of Zoab,
verses.4:21: the sons of Selom the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecha, and Madath the father of Maicha, and the generations of the houses of ephrath abak, of the house of Esoba;
verses.4:22: and Joakim, and the men of Sochetha, Joada and Saia, who dwelt in Moab; and he turned them back—abederein athoukiein.
verses.4:23: These were the potters who dwelt in Azaim and Gabaera with the king; in his kingdom they grew strong and dwelt there.
verses.4:24: The sons of Simeon were Nemuel, Jamin, Jarin, Zares, and Shaul;
verses.4:25: Salem his son, Mabasam his son, Masma his son,
verses.4:27: Shimei had sixteen sons and three daughters; and their brethren did not have many sons, nor did all their families multiply like the sons of Judah.
verses.4:28: And they dwelt in Beersheba, Sama, Moalda, and Hesereoulab,
verses.4:31: and Beth-mareimoth, Hemisusesoram, and the house of Braumseorim. These were their cities until King David.
verses.4:32: And their villages were Aitan, Remmon, Thokka, and Aisar—five cities;
verses.4:33: and all their villages round about these cities as far as Balat. This was their possession and their enrollment.
verses.4:34: And Mosobab, Jemoloch, and Joseia the son of Amaziah,
verses.4:35: and Joel; and he was the son of Isabia, the son of Saraau, the son of Asiel;
verses.4:36: and Elioenai, Jokaba, Jasuia, and Asia, the sons of Aosal, the son of Saphal,
verses.4:37: the son of Amon, the son of Idia, the son of Samar, the son of Simeon.
verses.4:38: These are the ones who made division by the names of princes in their generations; and in the houses of their fathers they multiplied into a multitude.
verses.4:39: And they went until they came to Gerar, to the east of Gai, to seek pastures for their livestock.
verses.4:40: And they found rich and good pastures, and the land was wide before them, with peace and quietness; for it belonged to those of the sons of Ham who had dwelt there beforehand.
verses.4:41: And these who were recorded by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck down their houses and the Minaeans whom they found there, and utterly destroyed them to this day; and they dwelt in their place, because there were pastures for their livestock there.
verses.4:42: And some of them, from the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, with Pelatiah, Noadiah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Jesthen, as their leaders.
verses.4:43: And they struck down those who were left, the remnant of Amalek, to this day.
verses.5:1: Now the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: for he was the firstborn, and when he went up to his father's bed, he gave his blessing to his son Joseph, the son of Israel, and he was not reckoned in the genealogy for the birthright;
verses.5:2: for Judah was mighty in strength even among his brethren, and from him came a ruler, yet the blessing belonged to Joseph.
verses.5:3: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch and Pallu, Harson and Carmi.
verses.5:4: The sons of Joel were Shimei, and Benaiah his son. And the sons of Gog the son of Shimei:
verses.5:5: his son Echa, his son Recha, his son Joel,
verses.5:6: his son Beel, whom Thalgabanasar king of Assyria carried away into exile; he was chief of the Reubenites.
verses.5:7: And his brethren by his family, in their enrollments according to their generations: the chief was Joel, and Zechariah,
verses.5:8: and Balec the son of Ozuz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel; he dwelt in Aroer, and as far as Nebo and Beelmasson,
verses.5:9: and toward the east he dwelt as far as the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, for he had much livestock in the land of Gilead.
verses.5:10: And in the days of Saul they made war against the sojourners, and they fell by their hands, dwelling in tents, even all of them toward the east of Gilead.
verses.5:11: The sons of Gad dwelt opposite them in Bashan as far as Elcha:
verses.5:12: Joel was the firstborn, and Sabat the second, and Janin the scribe in Bashan.
verses.5:13: And their brethren, according to the houses of their fathers, were Michael, Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Chima, and Zue, and Obed—eight.
verses.5:14: These were the sons of Abihaia, the sons of Huri, the son of Idai, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Isai, the son of Juri, the son of Zabucham,
verses.5:15: the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of fathers,
verses.5:16: of the inhabitants in Gilead, in Bashan and in their villages, and all the surrounding regions of Geriam as far as the border.
verses.5:17: The enrollment of all these took place in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.5:18: The sons of Reuben and Gad and half the tribe of Manasseh, from the sons of valor—men bearing shields and sword, drawing the bow, and trained in war—were forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty, going forth to battle.
verses.5:19: And they made war with the Hagrites, and the Turites, and the Naphisadaites, and the Nadabites.
verses.5:20: And they prevailed over them, and the Hagrites and all their tents were delivered into their hands; for they cried out to God in the battle, and He heard them, because they hoped in Him.
verses.5:21: And they took captive their possessions: five thousand camels, and two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, two thousand donkeys, and one hundred thousand souls of men;
verses.5:22: for many fell slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their place until the exile.
verses.5:23: And the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt from Bashan as far as Baalim and Senir and Mount Hermon; and in Lebanon they multiplied.
verses.5:24: And these were the heads of their fathers' house: Epher, and Shei, and Eliel, and Esdriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jeliel—mighty men of valor, men of renown, chiefs of the houses of their fathers.
verses.5:25: And they acted unfaithfully against the God of their fathers, and played the harlot after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had removed from before them.
verses.5:26: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Phaloch king of Assyria, and the spirit of Thagnaphamasar king of Assyria, and he carried away into exile Reuben, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Chaach and Habor and to the river Chozar, to this day.
verses.5:27: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.5:28: And the sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.5:29: And the children of Amram: Aaron and Moses and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.5:30: Eleazar fathered Phinehas; Phinehas fathered Abishua;
verses.5:31: Abishua fathered Bukki, and Bukki fathered Uzzi;
verses.5:32: Uzzi fathered Zerahiah; Zerahiah fathered Mariel;
verses.5:33: and Mariel fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub;
verses.5:34: and Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Ahimaaz;
verses.5:35: and Ahimaaz fathered Azariah, and Azariah fathered Johanan;
verses.5:36: and Johanan fathered Azariah; it was he who ministered as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
verses.5:37: And Azariah fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub;
verses.5:38: and Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Shallum;
verses.5:39: and Shallum fathered Hilkiah, and Hilkiah fathered Azariah;
verses.5:40: and Azariah fathered Seraiah, and Seraiah fathered Jehozadak.
verses.5:41: And Jehozadak went into the exile with Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.6:1: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.6:2: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.
verses.6:3: And the sons of Kohath were Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.6:4: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of Levi according to their families.
verses.6:5: Of Gershon: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.6:6: Joab his son, Adei his son, Jaara his son, Jethri his son.
verses.6:7: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Haresi his son,
verses.6:8: Elkanah his son, Suphi his son, Kainath his son,
verses.6:9: Kohath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, Shaul his son.
verses.6:10: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Alimoth,
verses.6:11: Elkanah, and Abiathar his son, Aseri his son,
verses.6:12: Eliab his son, Idaer his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.6:13: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn Sani, and Abijah.
verses.6:14: The sons: Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.6:15: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.6:16: And these are the ones whom David appointed over the direction of the singers in the house of the Lord at the resting of the ark.
verses.6:17: And they were ministering before the tabernacle of the house of testimony with instruments until Solomon built the house in Jerusalem; and they stood according to their ordinance for their services.
verses.6:18: And these are those who stood, and their sons. Of the sons of Kohath: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
verses.6:19: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroboam, the son of Eliel, the son of Tohu,
verses.6:20: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Meth, the son of Amathiu,
verses.6:21: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.6:22: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Abiasar, the son of Korah,
verses.6:23: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.6:24: And his brother Asaph, who stood at his right hand: Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.6:25: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
verses.6:26: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Aziah,
verses.6:27: the son of Ethan, the son of Zammam, the son of Shimei,
verses.6:28: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershon, the son of Levi.
verses.6:29: And the sons of Merari their brother, on the left: Etham the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.6:30: the son of Asebi, the son of Amaziah,
verses.6:31: the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
verses.6:32: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.6:33: And their brethren according to their fathers' houses, the Levites, were given to all the work of the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.6:34: And Aaron and his sons were offering incense on the altar of burnt offerings and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the Holy of Holies, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.6:35: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.6:36: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Seraiah his son,
verses.6:37: Mariel his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.6:38: Zadok his son, Ahisama his son.
verses.6:39: And these are their dwelling places in their villages within their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of their family of the Kohathites, for the lot fell to them.
verses.6:40: And they gave them Hebron in Judea, and its pasturelands all around it.
verses.6:41: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.6:42: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, and Libnah with its pasturelands, and Selna with its pasturelands, and Eshtemoa with its pasturelands,
verses.6:43: and Eglam with its pasturelands, and Gethoron with its pasturelands;
verses.6:44: and Ashan with its pasturelands, and Attan with its pasturelands, and Beth Shemesh;
verses.6:45: and from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its pasturelands, and Alemeth with its pasturelands, and Anchoch with its pasturelands. All their cities were thirteen cities according to their families.
verses.6:46: And to the remaining sons of Kohath, from the families, from the tribe, from the half-tribe of Manasseh, were given ten cities by lot.
verses.6:47: And to the sons of Gershon according to their families, from the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, were given thirteen cities.
verses.6:48: And to the sons of Merari according to their families, from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Dan, and from the tribe of Zebulun, were given twelve cities by lot.
verses.6:49: And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their pasturelands;
verses.6:50: and they gave by lot from the tribe of the sons of Judah and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon these cities which he named.
verses.6:51: And for some of the families of the sons of Kohath, the cities of their borders were from the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.6:52: And they gave him the cities of refuge: Shechem with its pasturelands in Mount Ephraim, and Gezer with its pasturelands,
verses.6:53: and Ikaam with its pasturelands, and Beth Horon with its pasturelands,
verses.6:55: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Amar with its pasturelands, by family, for the remaining sons of Kohath.
verses.6:56: To the sons of Gershon, from the families of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan of Bashan with its surrounding villages, and Aseroth with its pasturelands;
verses.6:57: and from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with its pasturelands, and Deberi with its pasturelands, and Dabor with its pasturelands;
verses.6:58: and Jethar with its pasturelands, and Debir with its pasturelands;
verses.6:59: and from the tribe of Asher: Maasa with its pasturelands, and Abaran with its pasturelands,
verses.6:60: and Hukok with its pasturelands, and Rehob with its pasturelands;
verses.6:61: and from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its pasturelands, and Hamoth with its pasturelands, and Kiriathaim with its pasturelands.
verses.6:62: To the remaining sons of Merari, from the tribe of Zebulun: Rimmon with its pasturelands, and Thachia with its pasturelands;
verses.6:63: from beyond the Jordan, and Jericho on the west of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasturelands,
verses.6:64: and Kadamos with its pasturelands, and Maephla with its pasturelands;
verses.6:65: and from the tribe of Gad: Rammon Gilead with its pasturelands, and Maanaith with its pasturelands,
verses.6:66: and Heshbon with its pasturelands, and Gazer with its pasturelands.
verses.7:1: And the sons of Issachar were Tholaek, Phut, Jassur, and Shimron—four.
verses.7:2: And the sons of Thole were Uzzi, Raphara, Reiel, Eikan, Basan, and Isamuel, heads of their fathers' houses belonging to Tholaei, mighty men of valor according to their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
verses.7:3: And the sons of Zeirrei were Zareia and Michael; and the sons of Zareia were Meibdeia, Rael, and Eisia—five, all of them chiefs.
verses.7:4: And with them, according to their generations, according to their fathers' houses, were mighty men fit to be arrayed for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had multiplied wives and sons.
verses.7:5: And their brethren throughout all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor as well, were eighty-seven thousand, the number of them all.
verses.7:7: And the sons of Badee were Asebon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Areimoth, and Uri—five, heads of fathers' houses, mighty men of valor; and their number was twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.
verses.7:8: And the sons of Abachei were Amarias, Joash, Eliezer, Eleithainan, Amareia, Auremoth, Abiud, Anathoth, and Gemeeth. All these were the sons of Amacheir,
verses.7:9: and their number according to their generations, heads of their fathers' houses, mighty men of valor, was twenty thousand two hundred.
verses.7:10: And the sons of Ariel were Balaan. And the sons of Balaan were Jeush, Benjamin, Aoth, Canaan, Zaithan, Ramessai, and Acheisadar.
verses.7:11: All these were the sons of Ariel, heads of their families, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, going forth in force to make war;
verses.7:12: and Sapphin and Happhin, and the sons of Raom, his son Aer.
verses.7:13: The sons of Naphtali were Jeisiel, Goni, Isseier, and Solomon, the sons of Balam.
verses.7:14: The sons of Manasseh were Asriel, whom his Syrian concubine bore; she bore Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.7:15: And Machir took a wife for Hamphin and Mamphin; and the name of his sister was Moocha, and the name of the second was Sapphaad.
verses.7:16: And Moocha the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Souros; his son was Ulam,
verses.7:17: Badam. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.7:18: And his sister Malecheth bore Isadek, Abiezer, and Maela.
verses.7:19: And the sons of Semeira were Jaaim, Shechem, Lakeeim, and Alialeim.
verses.7:20: And the sons of Ephraim were Sothalath; the sons of Laada: his son Noome,
verses.7:21: his son Zabed, his sons Ozar and Elaad; and the men of Gath who were born in the land slew him, because they came down to take their livestock.
verses.7:22: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and their brethren came to comfort him.
verses.7:23: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Bargaa, because, "It happened in evil in my house
verses.7:24: and among those who remained." And he built Lower and Upper Beth Horon. And the sons of Ozan were Seera
verses.7:25: and Raphe, his sons; Saraph and Thalees were his sons; Thaen was his son.
verses.7:26: To Gedson his son, Jeeth was his son, Zemma was his son,
verses.7:27: the sons of Nun, the sons of Joshua, his sons.
verses.7:28: And their possession and their dwelling were Bethel and its villages, toward the east Naarnan, toward the west Gezer and its villages, and Shechem and its villages as far as Gaian and its villages;
verses.7:29: and as far as the borders of the sons of Manasseh, Beth Shan and its villages, Thalme and its villages; and Balad and its villages, Megiddo and its villages, Dor and its villages. In this dwelt the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel.
verses.7:30: The sons of Asher were Inina, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriga, and Sore, and their sister.
verses.7:31: The sons of Bericha were Gaber and Melleie; he was the father of Bezaith.
verses.7:32: And Chaber fathered Iphamel, Samer, Chothan, and Sola their sister.
verses.7:33: And the sons of Aphalech were Baisechi, Imabael, and Aseith; these were the sons of Japhalel.
verses.7:34: And the sons of Semmer were Achiuia, Hobab, Akaran,
verses.7:35: and Balaam; his brethren were Sochath, Imana, Zeme, and Amaa.
verses.7:36: The sons of Sophas were Chuchi, Hanarphar, Sula, Sabrei, Imare,
verses.7:37: Basan, Oa, Sama, Salisa, Jethra, and Beera.
verses.7:38: And the sons of Jether were Iphina, Phasphai, and Ara;
verses.7:39: and the sons of Ola were Orech, Hanniel, and Raseia.
verses.7:40: All these were the sons of Asher, all of them heads of families, choice and mighty men of valor, chief leaders; their number for marshaling to make war—their number was twenty-six thousand men.
verses.8:1: Now Benjamin fathered Beleleel his firstborn, and Saba the second, Japhael the third,
verses.8:2: Joa the fourth, and Raphe the fifth.
verses.8:3: And the sons of Bela were Alei, Gera, and Abihud,
verses.8:6: These are the sons of Ehud; these are the heads of the fathers' houses of those who dwelt in Gaber, and they carried them away to Machanathi.
verses.8:7: And Nooma, Ahijah, and Gera—he, Higaam, fathered Naana and Jachichol.
verses.8:8: And Saarel fathered children in the plain of Moab after he had sent away Sosin and Ibaada his wife.
verses.8:9: And by Hada his wife he fathered Jobab, Jebia, Misa, and Melchas,
verses.8:10: and Idos, Sabia, and Imama. These were heads of the fathers' houses.
verses.8:11: And by Hosimen he fathered Abitub and Alphaad.
verses.8:12: And the sons of Alphaad were Obed, Messaam, and Semer; he built Onan and its villages.
verses.8:13: And Beriga and Sama—these were heads of the fathers' houses of those who dwelt in Ailam, and they drove out the inhabitants of Gath.
verses.8:14: And his brother Sokel, and Jeremoth,
verses.8:16: and Michael, Saphan, and Joachan were the sons of Beriga.
verses.8:18: Samari, Zaria, and Joab were the sons of Elchaad.
verses.8:21: Abijah, Beriga, Beraiah, and Samarath were the sons of Samaith.
verses.8:25: Athin, Jepheria, and Pheliel were the sons of Soiek.
verses.8:27: Jasaraia, Seraiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Iraam.
verses.8:28: These were heads of the fathers' houses, heads according to their generations; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.8:29: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, and his wife's name was Molcha.
verses.8:30: And her firstborn son was Abalon, and Zur, Kish, Baalakaim, Adad,
verses.8:31: Dur, his brother, Zachur, and Mikloth.
verses.8:32: And Mikloth fathered Shimeah. And indeed these dwelt opposite their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.
verses.8:33: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchishua, Amminadab, and Asabal.
verses.8:34: And the sons of Jonathan: Merib-Baal; and Merib-Baal fathered Michia.
verses.8:35: And the sons of Michia were Pithon, Melchel, Theree, and Zak.
verses.8:36: And Zak fathered Jad and Jada; and Jada fathered Salaimath, Salmo, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Maisa.
verses.8:37: And Maisa fathered Bana; Raphai was his son, Salasath his son, and Esel his son.
verses.8:38: And Esel had six sons, and these were their names: Ezrikai his firstborn, Ishmael, Seraiah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Esel.
verses.8:39: And the sons of Asel his brother were Elam his firstborn, Gag the second, and Eliphaleis the third.
verses.8:40: And the sons of Elam were mighty men of strength, drawing the bow and having many sons and sons' sons, one hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.9:1: Now all Israel had their enrollment, and these were recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, together with those who were resettled in Babylon in their iniquities.
verses.9:2: And those who dwelt formerly in their possessions in the cities of Israel were the Levite sons, the priests, and the given ones.
verses.9:3: And in Jerusalem there dwelt some of the sons of Judah, and some of the sons of Benjamin, and of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh:
verses.9:4: Gothi, and the son of Sammiu, the son of Omri, sons of the sons of Perez and of the son of Judah.
verses.9:5: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah his firstborn.
verses.9:6: Of the sons of Zerah: Epeiel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.9:7: And of the sons of Benjamin: Shallum the son of Moollam, the son of Hoduiah, the son of Haana;
verses.9:8: and Banaam the son of Iraam; and these were the sons of Uzzi, the son of Machir; and Masealem the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Benaiah;
verses.9:9: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six; all the men were chiefs of fathers' houses according to the houses of their fathers.
verses.9:10: And of the priests: Jodae, and Joarim, and Jachin,
verses.9:11: and Azariah, sons of Hilkiah, the son of Mosollom, the son of Zadok, the son of Marmoth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.9:12: and Adaiah the son of Iraam, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasaiah the son of Adiel, the son of Jediu, the son of Mosollam, the son of Maselmoth, the son of Immer;
verses.9:13: and their brethren, chiefs of their fathers' houses, one thousand seven hundred and sixty—mighty in strength for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.9:14: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Esrikan, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.9:15: and Bakar, and Raraiel, Galaad, and Manthanias the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.9:16: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galaad, the son of Jothon; and Barachi the son of Ossa, the son of Elkanah, who dwelt in the villages of Notephati.
verses.9:17: The gatekeepers were Shallum, Akum, Tammam, and Aimam, and their brethren; Shallum was the chief.
verses.9:18: And until this time they were at the king's gate toward the east; these were the gates of the camps of the sons of Levi.
verses.9:19: And Solomon the son of Koreb, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren of his father's house, the Korahites, were over the works of the service, keeping the watches of the tabernacle; and their fathers were over the camp, guarding the entrance.
verses.9:20: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar had been ruler over them formerly, and these were with him.
verses.9:21: Zechariah the son of Masalami was gatekeeper of the door of the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.9:22: All those chosen for the gates, at the gates, were two hundred and twelve; these were in their courts, according to their enrollment. These David and Samuel the seer appointed in their trust.
verses.9:23: And they and their sons were over the gates in the house of the Lord, in the house of the tabernacle, to keep watch.
verses.9:24: According to the four winds were the gates: toward the east, the sea, the north, and the south.
verses.9:25: And their brethren in their courts were to come in every seven days, from time to time, with these;
verses.9:26: for four mighty men of the gates are in trust. The Levites were over the chambers, and over the treasuries of the house of God they shall encamp;
verses.9:27: for upon them was the watch, and they were over the keys, morning by morning, to open the doors of the temple.
verses.9:28: And some of them were over the vessels of the service, for by number they shall bring them in.
verses.9:29: And some of them were appointed over the vessels, and over all the holy vessels, and over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.9:30: And some of the sons of the priests were makers of the ointment and for the spices.
verses.9:31: And Mattathias of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was in trust over the works of the offering of the pan of the high priest.
verses.9:32: And Benaiah the Kohathite, of their brethren, was over the loaves of the presentation, to prepare them Sabbath by Sabbath.
verses.9:33: And these were the singers, chiefs of the fathers' houses of the Levites, arranged in courses; for day and night were upon them in the works.
verses.9:34: These were the chiefs of the fathers' houses, chiefs according to their generations; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.9:35: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, and the name of his wife was Maacah.
verses.9:36: And his firstborn son was Sabadon, and Isir, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.9:37: and Jedur, and a brother, and Zechariah, and Makelloth.
verses.9:38: And Makelloth fathered Samaa. And these dwelt in the midst of their brethren in Jerusalem, in the midst of their brethren.
verses.9:39: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Amminadab, and Asabal.
verses.9:40: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-Baal, and Merib-Baal fathered Micah.
verses.9:41: And the sons of Micah were Pithon, and Malach, and Tharach.
verses.9:42: And Ahaz fathered Jada, and Jada fathered Gameleth, and Gazaoth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Massa.
verses.9:43: And Massa fathered Baana; Rephaiah was his son, and Esael was his son.
verses.9:44: And Esel had six sons, and these were their names: Esdrikan his firstborn, and Ishmael, and Seraiah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Esel.
verses.10:1: Now the foreigners fought against Israel, and they fled from before the foreigners and fell wounded on Mount Gilboa.
verses.10:2: And the foreigners pursued closely after Saul and after his sons; and the foreigners struck down Jonathan, and Amminadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
verses.10:3: And the battle pressed heavily upon Saul; and the archers found them with bows and pains, and they suffered pain from the bows.
verses.10:4: Then Saul said to his armorbearer, "Draw your sword and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised men come and mock me." But his armorbearer would not, for he was exceedingly afraid. Therefore Saul took the sword and fell upon it.
verses.10:5: And when his armorbearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell upon his own sword.
verses.10:6: So Saul died, and his three sons on that day, and all his house died together.
verses.10:7: And when every man of Israel who was in the valley saw that Israel had fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook their cities and fled; and the foreigners came and dwelt in them.
verses.10:8: And it came to pass on the next day that the foreigners came to strip the wounded, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.10:9: And they stripped him, and took his head and his armor, and sent them throughout the land of the foreigners all around, to proclaim the good news to their idols and to the people.
verses.10:10: And they placed their armor in the house of their god, and his head they placed in the house of Dagon.
verses.10:11: And all who dwelt in Gilead heard everything that the foreigners had done to Saul and to Israel.
verses.10:12: And every valiant man arose from Gilead, and they took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh; and they fasted seven days.
verses.10:13: So Saul died in his iniquities which he committed against God concerning the word of the Lord, because he did not keep it, and because Saul inquired of a medium to seek counsel, and Samuel the prophet answered him,
verses.10:14: and he did not seek the Lord. Therefore He slew him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
verses.11:1: And all Israel came to David at Hebron, saying, "Behold, we are your bones and your flesh.
verses.11:2: And both yesterday and the day before, when Saul was king, you were the one leading out and bringing in Israel. And the Lord of Israel said to you, 'You shall shepherd My people Israel, and you shall be a ruler over Israel.'"
verses.11:3: And all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David as king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Samuel.
verses.11:4: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; and there the Jebusites, who dwelt in Jebus,
verses.11:5: said to David, "You shall not enter here." And he captured the stronghold of Zion, which is the City of David.
verses.11:6: And David said, "Whoever strikes a Jebusite first shall be chief and commander." And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up against it first, and he became chief.
verses.11:7: And David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore he called it the City of David.
verses.11:8: And he built the city all around; and he fought and took the city.
verses.11:9: And David went on advancing, and the Lord Almighty was with him.
verses.11:10: And these are the chiefs of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
verses.11:11: And this is the number of the mighty men of David: Jesebada the son of Hachamani, first of the thirty; he drew his sword once against three hundred slain at one time.
verses.11:12: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodai, the Archonite; he was among the three mighty men.
verses.11:13: He was with David at Phasodome, and the foreigners were gathered together there for battle; and there was a portion of the field full of barley, and the people fled from before the foreigners.
verses.11:14: And he stood in the midst of the portion and delivered it, and he struck down the foreigners; and the Lord brought about a great deliverance.
verses.11:15: And three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David, to the cave of Adullam, while an encampment of the foreigners was in the Valley of the Giants.
verses.11:16: And David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the foreigners was then in Bethlehem.
verses.11:17: And David longed and said, "Who will give me water to drink from the cistern of Bethlehem, which is at the gate?"
verses.11:18: And the three broke through the encampment of the foreigners, and drew water from the cistern in Bethlehem, which was at the gate, and brought it to David; yet David would not drink it, and poured it out as a drink offering to the Lord,
verses.11:19: and said, "May God forbid that I should do this thing! Shall I drink the blood of these men at the peril of their lives? For at the peril of their lives they brought it." And he would not drink it. These things the three mighty men did.
verses.11:20: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three; he drew his sword against three hundred slain at one time, and he was renowned among the three.
verses.11:21: Of the three he was more honorable than the two, and he became their chief; yet he did not attain to the three.
verses.11:22: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a mighty man, whose deeds were many above Kabzeel—he struck down the two Ariels of Moab, and he went down and struck down the lion in the pit on a day of snow,
verses.11:23: and he struck down the Egyptian man, a remarkable man five cubits tall; and in the hand of the Egyptian was a spear like a weavers' beam. And Benaiah went down against him with a staff, and snatched the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.11:24: These things Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and he had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.11:25: He was more honorable than the thirty, yet he did not attain to the three; and David appointed him over his family.
verses.11:26: And the mighty men of the armies were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodoe of Bethlehem,
verses.11:27: Samaoth the Hadite, Chelles the Pelonite,
verses.11:28: Orai the son of Ektes the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
verses.11:29: Sobochai the Hathite, Eli the Achonite,
verses.11:30: Neere the Netophathite, Chthaod the son of Nooza the Netophathite,
verses.11:31: Airei the son of Rebie from the hill of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.11:32: Hurai from Nachali of Gaash, Abiel the Garabaithite,
verses.11:33: Azbon the Beerminite, Samaba the Homite;
verses.11:34: Bennaias the Somologennunite, Jonathan the son of Sola the Harachite,
verses.11:35: Achim the son of Achar the Hararite, Elphat the son of Sthur,
verses.11:37: Hesere the Charmadaite, Naarai the son of Azobai,
verses.11:38: Joel the son of Nathan, Mebaal the son of Hagari,
verses.11:39: Sele the Ammonite, Nahor the Berthite, the armor-bearer to the son of Zeruiah,
verses.11:41: Uri the Hittite, Zabet the son of Achaia,
verses.11:42: Adina the son of Saiza, a chief of Reuben, and with him were thirty,
verses.11:43: Hanan the son of Moocha, and Jehoshaphat the Baithanite,
verses.11:44: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Samatha and Jeia, the sons of Kothan the Ararite,
verses.11:45: Eltheiel the son of Sameri, and Joazae his brother, the Jeasite,
verses.11:46: Leiel the Mieite, and Jaribi, and Joseia his son, Ellaam, and Ethema the Moabite,
verses.11:47: Daleiel, and Jobeth, and Esseiel of Meinabea.
verses.12:1: Now these were the ones who came to David at Sokla, while he was still hemmed in because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, helpers in war,
verses.12:2: wielding the bow with both the right hand and the left, and slingers with stones and with bows, of the brethren of Saul from Benjamin:
verses.12:3: Ahiezer the chief, and Joa the son of Ama the Gebothite, and Joel and Jophalet the sons of Asmoth, and Berchia, and Jehul the Anathothite,
verses.12:4: and Samaias the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and over the thirty; Jeremiah, and Jezel, and Johanan, and Joazabab the Gadarathite;
verses.12:6: Azai, and Arimuth, and Badaia, and Samaraia, and Saphatia the Charaiphite;
verses.12:7: Elkanah, and Jesuni, and Ozriel, and Jozara, and Sobokam, and the Korahites;
verses.12:8: and Elia and Zabidia, the sons of Raam, and those of Gedor.
verses.12:9: And from the Gadites there separated themselves to David from the wilderness strong, mighty men of battle array, bearing shields and spears, whose faces were like the face of a lion, and nimble as gazelles upon the mountains in swiftness:
verses.12:10: Aza the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.12:11: Masemmane the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.12:12: Ethoi the sixth, Eliab the seventh,
verses.12:13: Joan the eighth, Eliazer the ninth,
verses.12:14: Jeremiah the tenth, Melchabannai the eleventh.
verses.12:15: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: the least was one over a hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
verses.12:16: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they drove out all those who dwelt in the valleys, from the east to the west.
verses.12:17: And some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the help of David.
verses.12:18: And David went out to meet them and said to them, "If you have come to me in peace, may my heart be wholly united toward you; but if to deliver me to my enemies, not in truth of hand, may the God of your fathers behold it and rebuke you."
verses.12:19: Then the Spirit clothed Amasai, chief of the thirty, and he said, "Go forward, you and your people, David son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers! For your God has helped you." So David received them and appointed them captains of the forces.
verses.12:20: And from Manasseh some went over to David when the Philistines came against Saul to battle; yet they did not help them, for counsel was taken by the commanders of the Philistines, saying, "With the heads of those men he will return to his master Saul."
verses.12:21: As he went to Soglam, there went over to him from Manasseh: Edna, and Tozabath, and Rhodiel, and Michael, and Josabaith, and Elimuth, and Semathi, who are captains of thousands of Manasseh.
verses.12:22: And they fought alongside David against the Geddur, for they were all mighty men of valor; and they were leaders in the army, in the host,
verses.12:23: for day by day they came to David into a great host, like the host of God.
verses.12:24: Now these are the names of the captains of the army who came to David at Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul over to him, according to the word of the Lord:
verses.12:25: of the sons of Judah, bearing shields and spears, six thousand eight hundred mighty men of battle array;
verses.12:26: of the sons of Simeon, mighty men of valor for battle array, seven thousand one hundred;
verses.12:27: of the sons of Levi, four thousand six hundred;
verses.12:28: and Toadas, the leader of Aaron, and with him three thousand seven hundred;
verses.12:29: and Zadok, a young man mighty in valor, and from his father's house twenty-two captains;
verses.12:30: and of the sons of Benjamin, the brethren of Saul, three thousand; for until then the greater part of them still kept watch over the charge of the house of Saul;
verses.12:31: and from the sons of Ephraim, twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty in valor, men of renown according to the houses of their fathers;
verses.12:32: and from the half-tribe of Manasseh, eighteen thousand, who were designated by name to make David king;
verses.12:33: and from the sons of Issachar, men having understanding of the times, knowing what Israel ought to do, two hundred; and all their brethren were with them;
verses.12:34: and from Zebulun, those who went forth to battle array with all weapons of war, fifty thousand, to help David not empty-handed;
verses.12:35: and from Naphtali, one thousand captains, and with them, with shields and spears, thirty-seven thousand;
verses.12:36: and from the Danites, arrayed for battle, twenty-eight thousand eight hundred;
verses.12:37: and from Asher, those who went forth to help in battle, forty thousand;
verses.12:38: and from beyond the Jordan, from Reuben and Gad and from the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all weapons of war, one hundred twenty thousand.
verses.12:39: All these were men of war, drawing up in battle array with a peaceful soul, and they came to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and the rest of Israel was also of one soul to make David king.
verses.12:40: And they were there three days eating and drinking, for their brethren had made preparation.
verses.12:41: Moreover, those who were near to them, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought to them upon camels and donkeys and mules and oxen provisions—flour, cakes of figs, raisins, wine and oil, and oxen and sheep in abundance—for there was gladness in Israel.
verses.13:1: And David took counsel with the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, and with every leader.
verses.13:2: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to you, and if it has been prospered by the Lord our God, let us send out to your brethren who remain in all the land of Israel, and with them the priests, the Levites, in the cities of their possession, that they may be gathered together to us;
verses.13:3: and let us bring over the ark of our God to us, for they have not sought it since the days of Saul."
verses.13:4: And all the assembly said that they would do so, for the word was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.13:5: So David assembled all Israel together, from the borders of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring in the ark of God from the city of Jearim.
verses.13:6: And David brought it up; and all Israel went up to the city of David, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God the Lord, who sits enthroned upon the cherubim, where His name was called upon.
verses.13:7: And they set the ark of God on a new cart from the house of Aminadab; and Uzzah and his brethren drove the cart.
verses.13:8: And David and all Israel were playing before God with all their might, with singers, and with lyres, and with harps, with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.13:9: And they came to the threshing floor; and Uzzah stretched out his hand to take hold of the ark, and the ox tilted it.
verses.13:10: And the Lord was angry with Uzzah, and He struck him there because he stretched out his hand to the ark; and he died there before God.
verses.13:11: And David was downcast because the Lord had broken out with a breach upon Uzzah; and he called that place Breach of Uzzah, to this day.
verses.13:12: And David feared God that day, saying, "How shall I bring the ark of God in to myself?"
verses.13:13: So David did not bring the ark back to himself into the city of David, but turned it aside into the house of Abeddara the Gittite.
verses.13:14: And the ark of God remained in the house of Abeddara three months; and God blessed Abeddaram and all that belonged to him.
verses.14:1: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar timbers, and builders, and carpenters in wood, to build him a house.
verses.14:2: And David knew that the Lord had established him over Israel, because his kingdom was exalted on high for the sake of His people Israel.
verses.14:3: And David took more wives in Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to David.
verses.14:4: And these are the names of those born to him, who were his in Jerusalem: Samaa, Isoboam, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.14:5: and Baar, and Ektae, and Eliphaleth,
verses.14:6: and Nageth, and Naphath, and Janou,
verses.14:7: and Elisamae, and Balegdae, and Emphalet.
verses.14:8: Now when the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out to meet them.
verses.14:9: And the Philistines came and converged in the Valley of the Giants.
verses.14:10: And David inquired through God, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines, and will You deliver them into my hands?" And the Lord said to him, "Go up, and I will deliver them into your hands."
verses.14:11: So he went up to Phaalphathisim, and David struck them there; and David said, "He has broken through my enemies by my hand like a breakthrough of water." Therefore he called the name of that place Breach of Pharisin.
verses.14:12: And they abandoned their gods, and David gave command to burn them with fire.
verses.14:13: And the Philistines once again converged in the Valley of the Giants.
verses.14:14: Therefore David inquired again of God, and God said to him, "You shall not go after them; turn away from them, and come upon them near the pear trees.
verses.14:15: And it shall be, when you hear the sound of the shaking of the very tops of the pear trees, then you shall go out to battle, for God has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines."
verses.14:16: So he did just as God commanded him, and he struck the camp of the Philistines from Gibeon as far as Gazara.
verses.14:17: And the name of David was spread abroad in all the land, and the Lord put the fear of him upon all the nations.
verses.15:1: And he made houses for himself in the city of David, and he prepared the place for the ark of God and made a tent for it.
verses.15:2: Then David said, "No one is to bear the ark of God except the Levites, for the Lord has chosen them, even to minister to Him forever."
verses.15:3: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the Lord to the place which he had prepared for it.
verses.15:4: And David gathered together the sons of Aaron, the Levites:
verses.15:5: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brethren, one hundred and ten;
verses.15:6: of the sons of Merari, Asai the chief, and his brethren, two hundred and fifty;
verses.15:7: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brethren, one hundred and fifty;
verses.15:8: of the sons of Elisaphat, Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren, two hundred;
verses.15:9: of the sons of Hebron, Ener the chief, and their brethren, eighty;
verses.15:10: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brethren, one hundred and twelve.
verses.15:11: And David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and the Levites: Ariel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Enel, and Amminadab.
verses.15:12: And he said to them, "You are the chiefs of the fathers' houses of the Levites; sanctify yourselves, you and your brethren, and you shall bring up the ark of the God of Israel to the place where I have prepared for it.
verses.15:13: For because you were not there at the first, our God broke forth against us, because we did not inquire according to the ordinance."
verses.15:14: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the God of Israel.
verses.15:15: And the sons of the Levites took up the ark of God, as Moses had commanded by the word of God according to the writing, with poles upon themselves.
verses.15:16: And David said to the chiefs of the Levites, "Appoint their brethren, the singers, with instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals—to raise a sound on high with a voice of gladness."
verses.15:17: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari his brethren, Ethan the son of Kishaiah;
verses.15:18: and with them their brethren of the second rank: Zechariah, Uzziel, Shemiramoth, Jeiel, Elioel, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphena, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Uzziah, the gatekeepers.
verses.15:19: And the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were with cymbals of bronze to make them heard;
verses.15:20: and Zechariah, Uzziel, Shemiramoth, Eithel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah with harps according to Alamoth;
verses.15:21: and Mattithiah, Enphanaiah, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Uzziah with lyres on the Amasenith, to lead with strength.
verses.15:22: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was chief of the songs, for he was understanding.
verses.15:23: And Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.15:24: And Somniah, Jehoshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were blowing the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jeiah were gatekeepers for the ark of God.
verses.15:25: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands were going to bring up the ark of the covenant from the house of Obed-Edom with gladness.
verses.15:26: And it came to pass, when God strengthened the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they sacrificed seven calves and seven rams each.
verses.15:27: And David was girded with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the singers, and Jechoniah the chief of the songs of the singers; and upon David was a robe of fine linen.
verses.15:28: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting and with the sound of the shofar, with trumpets and with cymbals, sounding aloud with harps and with lyres.
verses.15:29: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked down through the window and saw King David dancing and making merry; and she despised him in her soul.
verses.16:1: And they brought in the ark of God and set it in the midst of the tent which David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.16:2: And when David had finished offering the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
verses.16:3: And he distributed to every person of Israel, from man even to woman, to each one a single baker's loaf of bread and a sweet cake.
verses.16:4: And he appointed certain of the Levites before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister, to lift up their voices, and to give thanks and praise the Lord, the God of Israel:
verses.16:5: Asaph the leader, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jeiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel with instruments—harps and lyres—and Asaph sounding aloud with cymbals,
verses.16:6: and Benaiah and Uzziel the priests with the trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God
verses.16:7: on that day. Then David first appointed to praise the Lord by the hand of Asaph and his brethren. A Song.
verses.16:8: Give thanks, call upon Him in His name; make known His deeds among the peoples.
verses.16:9: Sing to Him and sing praises to Him; declare to all His wondrous works which the Lord has done.
verses.16:10: Praise in His holy name; the heart that seeks His good pleasure shall rejoice.
verses.16:11: Seek and be strong; seek His face continually.
verses.16:12: Remember His wondrous works which He has done, wonders and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.16:13: O seed of Israel, His servants, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.16:14: The Lord is our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.16:15: We remember His covenant forever, His word which He commanded for a thousand generations,
verses.16:16: which He made with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac.
verses.16:17: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, to Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.16:18: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the allotment of your inheritance,"
verses.16:19: when they were few in number, as they were diminished and sojourned in it.
verses.16:20: And they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people.
verses.16:21: He did not permit any man to oppress them, and He rebuked kings for their sakes:
verses.16:22: "Do not touch My anointed ones; do not act wickedly against My prophets."
verses.16:23: Sing to the Lord, all the earth; proclaim His salvation from day to day.
verses.16:25: For the Lord is great and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.16:26: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but our God made heaven.
verses.16:27: Glory and praise are before His face; strength and exultation are in His place.
verses.16:28: Give to the Lord, the Father of the nations; give to the Lord glory and strength,
verses.16:29: take gifts and bring them before His face, and worship the Lord in His holy courts.
verses.16:30: Let all the earth fear before His face; let the earth be established firmly and not be shaken.
verses.16:31: Let heaven rejoice, and let the earth be glad; and let them say among the nations, "The Lord reigns."
verses.16:32: The sea shall roar with its fullness, the tree of the field and all that is in it.
verses.16:33: Then the trees of the forest shall rejoice before the face of the Lord, for He has come to judge the earth.
verses.16:34: Give thanks to the Lord, for it is good; for His mercy endures forever.
verses.16:35: And say, "The God of our salvation has saved us; and deliver us from the nations, to praise Your holy name and to glory in Your praises."
verses.16:36: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from everlasting. And all the people shall say, "Amen." And they praised the Lord.
verses.16:37: And they left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as each day required;
verses.16:38: and Obed-Edom and his brethren, sixty-eight; and Obed-Edom the son of Jeduthun and Hosah as gatekeepers;
verses.16:39: and Zadok the priest and his brethren the priests before the tabernacle of the Lord at Bama, which is in Gibeon,
verses.16:40: to offer burnt offerings to the Lord upon the altar of burnt offering continually, morning and evening, and according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, all that He commanded concerning the sons of Israel by the hand of Moses the servant of God.
verses.16:41: And with him were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen by name to praise the Lord, "For His mercy endures forever";
verses.16:42: and with them were trumpets and cymbals for sounding aloud, and instruments for the songs of God; and the sons of Jeduthun were for the gate.
verses.16:43: And all the people departed, every man to his own house; and David returned to bless his house.
verses.17:1: Now it came to pass, when David dwelt in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, "Behold, I dwell in a house of cedar, yet the ark of the covenant of the Lord is beneath curtains of skin."
verses.17:2: And Nathan said to David, "Do all that is in your soul, for God is with you."
verses.17:3: Now it came to pass in that night that the word of the Lord came to Nathan:
verses.17:4: "Go and say to David My servant, 'Thus says the Lord: You shall not build a house for Me to dwell in.
verses.17:5: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought up Israel to this day,
verses.17:6: but I have been in a tent and under a covering in all places where I have walked among all Israel. Did I ever speak a word to any one tribe of Israel to shepherd My people, saying, "Why have you not built for Me a house of cedar?"'
verses.17:7: Now therefore, thus shall you say to My servant David, 'Thus says the Lord Almighty: I took you from the sheepfold, from following the flocks, to be ruler over My people Israel,
verses.17:8: and I have been with you in all places wherever you have gone, and I have utterly destroyed all your enemies from before your face, and I have made for you a name like the name of the great ones who are upon the earth.
verses.17:9: Moreover, I will appoint a place for My people Israel and will plant them, and they shall dwell by themselves and shall be anxious no more; neither shall unrighteousness again humble them as at the beginning,
verses.17:10: even from the days that I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I have humbled all your enemies, and I will increase you; and the Lord will build you up.
verses.17:11: And it shall be, when your days are fulfilled and you shall sleep with your fathers, that I will raise up your seed after you, who shall come from your own body, and I will prepare his kingdom.
verses.17:12: He shall build Me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
verses.17:13: I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to Me a son; and My mercy I will not withdraw from him, as I withdrew it from those who were before you.
verses.17:14: And I will confirm him in My house and in his kingdom forever, and his throne shall be established forever.'"
verses.17:15: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.17:16: Then King David came and sat before the Lord, and said, "Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my house, that You have loved me forever?
verses.17:17: Yet this was a small thing in Your sight, O God, and You have also spoken concerning the house of Your servant for times afar off; and You have looked upon me as the vision of a man, and have exalted me, O Lord God.
verses.17:18: What more shall David add to You to glorify You? For You know Your servant,
verses.17:19: and according to Your own heart You have done all this greatness.
verses.17:20: O Lord, there is none like You, nor is there any besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.17:21: And there is no other nation upon the earth like Your people Israel, whom God led to redeem for Himself a people, to make for Himself a great and glorious name, to drive out nations from before Your people, whom You redeemed from Egypt.
verses.17:22: For You have appointed Your people Israel as Your own people forever; and You, O Lord, are God to them.
verses.17:23: And now, O Lord, let Your word which You have spoken to Your servant and concerning his house be confirmed forever,
verses.17:24: as men say, 'Lord, Lord Almighty, God of Israel!' And let the house of David Your servant be established before You.
verses.17:25: For You have opened the ear of Your servant, that You would build him a house; therefore Your servant has found courage to pray before You.
verses.17:26: And now, O Lord, You Yourself are God, and You have spoken these good things concerning Your servant.
verses.17:27: And now You have begun to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You; for You have blessed it, so bless it forever."
verses.18:1: Now it came to pass after this that David struck the Philistines and routed them, and he took Gath and its villages from the hand of the Philistines.
verses.18:2: And he struck Moab, and the Moabites became servants to David, bringing gifts.
verses.18:3: And David struck Hadarezer king of Zobah-Hamath, as he went to establish his power at the river Euphrates.
verses.18:4: And David captured from them one thousand chariots, seven thousand horses, and twenty thousand men; and David disabled all the chariots, yet left for himself one hundred chariots from among them.
verses.18:5: And the Syrians from Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, and he struck twenty-two thousand men among the Syrians.
verses.18:6: Then David placed a garrison in Syria of Damascus, and they became servants to David, bringing gifts. And the Lord preserved David wherever he went.
verses.18:7: And David took the golden collars that were upon the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.18:8: And from Metabechas and from the choice wars of Hadarezer, David took exceedingly much bronze; from it Solomon made the bronze sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.
verses.18:9: Now Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck the entire army of Hadarezer king of Zobah,
verses.18:10: so he sent Hadoram his son to King David to inquire of his welfare and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadarezer and struck him—for Tou was an adversary in war to Hadarezer—along with all kinds of vessels of silver and gold.
verses.18:11: These also David consecrated to the Lord, along with the silver and the gold that he had taken from all the nations—from Idumea, and Moab, and from the sons of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.18:12: Moreover, Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck Idumea in the Valley of Salt, eighteen thousand;
verses.18:13: and he placed garrisons in the valley, and all the Idumeans became servants to David. And the Lord preserved him wherever he went.
verses.18:14: So David reigned over all Israel, and he was executing judgment and righteousness for all his people.
verses.18:15: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahijah was recorder;
verses.18:16: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests; Joshua was scribe;
verses.18:17: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the priests and Phalteia; and the sons of David were the chief deputies of the king.
verses.19:1: Now it came to pass after this that the king of the sons of Ammon died, and Hanan his son reigned in his place.
verses.19:2: Then David said, "I will show mercy to Hanan the son of Hanas, as his father showed mercy to me." So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And the servants of David came into the land of the sons of Ammon to comfort him.
verses.19:3: And the princes of Ammon said to Hanan, "Is it to honor your father in your sight that he has sent comforters to you? Have his servants not come to you in order to search out the city, to spy out the land?"
verses.19:4: Therefore Hanan took the servants of David and shaved them, and cut off half of their robes up to the waist, and sent them away.
verses.19:5: And they came to report to David concerning the men, and he sent to meet them, for they were exceedingly disgraced. And the king said, "Remain in Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return."
verses.19:6: And the sons of Ammon saw that the people of David had been put to shame; so Hanan and the sons of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Syria of Mesopotamia, from Syria of Maacah, and from Sobal.
verses.19:7: So they hired for themselves chariots and horsemen—thirty-two thousand chariots—and the king of Maacah and his people, who came and encamped opposite Medeba. Also the sons of Ammon gathered together from their cities and came to battle.
verses.19:8: And David heard of it, and sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
verses.19:9: Then the sons of Ammon came out and drew up in battle array beside the gate of the city, while the kings who had come encamped by themselves in the plain.
verses.19:10: And Joab saw that they were arrayed against him to fight, both in front and behind; so he chose from all the young men of Israel, and they drew up in battle array against the Syrians.
verses.19:11: And the remainder of the people he placed in the hand of Abishai his brother, and they drew up in battle array opposite the sons of Ammon.
verses.19:12: And he said, "If the Syrians prevail over me, then you shall be my deliverance; and if the sons of Ammon prevail over you, then I will deliver you.
verses.19:13: And the Lord will do what is good."
verses.19:14: So Joab and the people who were with him drew up opposite the Syrians for battle, and they fled from him.
verses.19:15: And when the sons of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they also fled from before Joab and from before his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.19:16: And when the Syrians saw that Israel had routed them, they sent messengers and brought out the Syrians from beyond the river, with Shophar the commander of the army of Hadarezer before them.
verses.19:17: When this was reported to David, he gathered all Israel together, crossed the Jordan, came upon them, and drew up in battle array against them. And the Syrians drew up in battle array opposite David and fought against him.
verses.19:18: Then the Syrians fled from before David; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand chariots and forty thousand foot soldiers, and he also slew Shaphath the commander of the army.
verses.19:19: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they had been defeated before Israel, they made a covenant with David and served him. So the Syrians were no longer willing to help Ammon.
verses.20:1: And it came to pass in the following year, at the going forth of the kings, that Joab led out the whole force of the army, and they laid waste the land of the sons of Ammon; and he came and besieged Rabbah. Now David remained in Jerusalem; and he struck Rabbah and tore it down.
verses.20:2: And David took the crown of Molchol their king from his head, and its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and in it was a precious stone, and it was upon the head of David; and he brought out very great spoil from the city.
verses.20:3: And he brought out the people who were in it, and sawed them with saws and with iron adzes; and thus David did to the servants, the sons of Ammon. Then David and all his people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.20:4: And it came to pass after these things that there was again war in Gezer with the foreigners; at that time Sobochai the Thosathite struck down Saphut, who was of the sons of the giants, and humbled him.
verses.20:5: And there was again war with the foreigners, and Ellan the son of Jair struck down Elemee the brother of Goliath the Gittite, and the shaft of his spear was like a weavers' beam.
verses.20:6: And there was again war in Gath, and there was a man of exceeding stature, and his fingers and toes were six and six, twenty-four; and he also was a descendant of the giants.
verses.20:7: And he reproached Israel, and Jonathan the son of Shammah, the son of David's brother, struck him down.
verses.20:8: This one was born to Rapha in Gath; all of them were four giants, and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
verses.21:1: And the devil stood up in Israel, and incited David to number Israel.
verses.21:2: And King David said to Joab and to the commanders of the army, "Go now, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan, and bring it to me, and I shall know their number."
verses.21:3: And Joab said, "May the Lord add to His people a hundredfold as many as they are, while the eyes of my lord the king behold it; all of them are servants to my lord. Why does my lord seek this thing? Do not let it become a sin to Israel."
verses.21:5: And Joab gave the number of the muster of the people to David; and all Israel was one million one hundred thousand men who drew the sword.
verses.21:6: But Levi and Benjamin he did not number among them, because the word of the king prevailed over Joab.
